name: Sandglass
summary: A shop admin in iPhone-style frosted glass over warm desert dunes, with a shop till
about: A complete admin for a small attar and skincare brand that sells online, in its own shop and through wholesale stockists. Warm frosted glass panels float over drawn dunes whose sky follows the time of day, a dock at the bottom grows under the pointer, and an hourglass fills with today's sales against the target. Orders, a shop-floor till, stockists, products, customers and insights all work.
how: Hover the dock at the bottom: icons grow like a phone dock; tap one to change page.
Watch the hourglass on Today pour sand as new web orders arrive, and set your own daily target.
Open an order to pack and ship it, write a gift note or accept a return.
Ring up a shop sale on Shop floor with SCENT10, then take cash with change, card or a wallet.
Restock a stockist from their card: stock leaves your shelves and they are invoiced at stockist prices.
In Settings, let the desert sky follow the clock, switch day and night glass, or reset the demo.
